kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جُلَاهِق or جَلَاهِق • (julāhiq or jalāhiq) m (plural جُلَاهِقَات (julāhiqāt) or جَلَاهِقَات (jalāhiqāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the Middle Persian ancestor of Classical Persian جولاهک (jūlāhak).
g: a reel or ball of thread
bullets for shooting by means of a sling or crossbow, projectiles
